title: Airplane Adapter
text:
Airplane Adapter.
AIRLINE ADAPTER Don't be stuck with using the airline's cheap headphones. The airplane adaptor allows you to connect your own wired headphones with a 3.5mm audio jack to the plane's entertainment system that uses the dual socket connector.

title: BuddyCable
text:
BuddyCable.
DETACHABLE CABLE WITH BUILT-IN MICROPHONE AND AUDIO SHARING The BuddyCable has a flat design for less entanglement and lower choking risk. It is also detachable so it comes out of the headphones if pulled, maximizing the safety for your child. A built-in microphone makes BuddyPhones ideal for calling family, friends, and other buddies. The audio splitter can connect up to 3 more BuddyCables, allowing a total of 4 kids to share the same device. The BuddyCable is compatible with all our wired and wireless BuddyPhones.

title: BuddyPhones School+ Wireless
text:
BuddyPhones School+ Wireless.
AWARD WINNING HEADPHONESWinner of the CES Innovation Award 2021, BuddyPhones are recognized as the top safe headphones for children, known for their innovative design and features. PERFECT FOR YOUNG KIDS & BIG KIDSBuddyPhones School+ are designed to fit kids between the ages of 5 to 12. The kids headphones are foldable & adjustable, fitting pleasantly. Ear cups are made with hypoallergenic, durable materials, comfortable for all day wear. Let your child personalize their headphones with various decorative stickers included, featuring fun characters and patterns. Kids can decorate their headphones to their hearts’ delight, making them their uniquely theirs. AWARD-WINNING SAFE AUDIO® FOR KIDS - PROTECTS YOUNG EARSProtecting young ears is a top priority with Safe Audio®. According to the Journal of Pediatrics, "12.5% of kids between the ages of 6 and 19 suffer from hearing loss as a result of using earphones turned to a high volume". That's why these Bluetooth kids headphones come with built-in volume control that keeps your child’s hearing safe. You can choose from three sound levels—75dB, 85dB, or 94dB—to make sure the volume never gets too loud. EXCEPTIONAL EDUCATIONAL TOOLTo help with the growing demand for online classes or home study, School+ Wireless headphones include a high quality detachable boom microphone and our patented Study Mode. This sound enhancing mode filters and clarifies audio voices so they’re easier to understand. Our patented BuddyLink system allows listeners to share audio - ideal for in school settings or with educational Apps. Access the call, playback and volume controls easily and remotely from the built-in buttons on the back of the ear cups. BUILT TO LAST - PARENT APPROVEDBuddyPhones headphones are tough enough for everyday rough play. Parents love that kids can toss, pull, and stretch them without damage. Durable, reliable, and designed for active lifestyles, these kid headphones are a smart, long-lasting choice for kids. MADE WITH WORRY-FREE MATERIALSWe go beyond safety with our SafeAudio® volume-limiting technology by carefully selecting materials that are safe for children. We use only BPA- and phthalate-free plastics, ensuring your child avoids exposure to harmful chemicals found in many plastics. BUDDIES FOR LIFEBuddyPhones are engineered constructed and tested for robustness capable of withstanding even the roughest handling by kids. Our quality control process includes testing at world-class labs to ensure durability.
Selected option: School Blue.

title: StoryPhones with PlayShield + ZenShield
text:
StoryPhones with PlayShield + ZenShield.
AWARD WINNING HEADPHONESWinner of the 2021 and 2023 Silver Product Safety Awards, Time’s Best Inventions 2022, and the CES Innovation Award 2022, StoryPhones are recognized as the top safe headphones for children, known for their innovative design and features. A SCREEN-FREE ENTERTAINMENT EXPERIENCEStoryPhones by themselves are high-quality Bluetooth headphones for when you want to have the option. Adding StoryShields brings screen-free audio stories, music, and educational content wherever your kids go, letting them immerse themselves in creativity and enriching their imagination, culture, and vocabulary. SAFE AUDIO® - PROTECTS YOUNG EARSProtecting young ears is a top priority with Safe Audio®. According to the Journal of Pediatrics, "12.5% of kids between the ages of 6 and 19 suffer from hearing loss as a result of using earphones turned to a high volume". That's why these Bluetooth kid storytelling headphones come with certified, built-in volume control that keeps your child’s hearing safe. You can choose from three sound levels—75dB, 85dB, or 94dB—to make sure the volume never gets too loud. UNIQUE CONTENT FOR EVERY ADVENTURERecord your own stories, lullabies, or family memories with the customizable PlayShield. Help sleep and relaxation with ZenShield's 6 relaxing high-fidelity soothing sounds, to help overstimulated kids calm down, relax, and even sleep. Expand your libary with StoryShields from Disney, Pinna, LingoKids, and More! DESIGNED FOR KIDS, LOVED BY PARENTSStoryPhones make listening fun, safe, and screen-free—perfect for curious young minds. These award-winning headphones feature up to 20 hours of battery life, a built-in microphone, and the flexibility to use them wired or wireless. Compatible with the entire StoryShield library, StoryPhones open a world of imagination and learning without screens. Manage stories easily through the StoryPhones app, available on the Apple App Store and Google Play—because safe, creative listening should be simple for kids and reassuring for parents. 3 WAYS TO LISTENStoryMode (offline access to stories and educational content while travelling, in a restaurant or relaxing), BluetoothMode (high-quality bluetooth experience when screen or music time is desired), WiredMode (Use with cable connected when battery is low or wired use is desired)
Selected option: StoryPhones White.
